methodologyNotes: Products selected as notable soundbars a buyer compares in 2026, spanning ultra-premium home-theater systems, mid-range Atmos bars, and entry-level models. Primary sources were manufacturer/authoritative product pages (sonos.com, bose.com, lg.com, denon.com, samsung.com, dolby.com) plus rtings.com and review articles from digitaltrends.com, techradar.com, whathifi.com, ecoustics.com, and tomsguide.com. Verification pass (2026-06-15) corrected several values: Samsung HW-Q990D priceUsd corrected to $1,999.99 (from an erroneous $1,299) per Samsung.com / Best Buy / Crutchfield, and its dts_x corrected to true (What Hi-Fi, RTINGS, TechRadar confirm DTS:X). LG S95TR release year corrected to 2024 (from 2023) per RTINGS/Best Buy/Amazon; $1,599.99 MSRP confirmed on LG.com. Sony Bravia Theatre Bar 9 channels corrected to 5.0.2 (from a fabricated 7.0.4) and total_watts set to 585 per Dolby's official spec page and ecoustics. Bose Smart Ultra priceUsd corrected to $899 launch MSRP (later raised to $999). Sony HT-S2000 priceUsd set to $499.99. priceUsd is US launch MSRP unless noted; current street prices may differ. accessedAt=2026-06-15 on all sources.

products.name: Sonos Arc Ultra
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP per Digital Trends review ($999.00 listed in review header, November 2024). Sonos.com later repriced to $1,099 MSRP with a $200 promotional discount to $899 as of June 2026.
products.provenance: Channels (9.1.4), Dolby Atmos, HDMI eARC, Sonos Voice Control + Alexa, and $999 launch price confirmed from Digital Trends review (published November 6, 2024). Sub and rear speakers sold separately. Total watts not disclosed by Sonos. DTS:X not supported per review. Sonos.com confirms HDMI eARC/ARC connection, current sale price $899 (from $1,099 updated MSRP).

products.name: Sonos Beam (Gen 2)
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (September 2021) per Sonos.com ($499). Sonos.com showed $369 sale price (from $499) as of June 2026.
products.provenance: Dolby Atmos (virtual height processing via phantom channels), HDMI eARC, Alexa + Google Assistant confirmed from both Sonos.com and Digital Trends review. $499 MSRP confirmed from Sonos.com (current sale $369). Channels 3.0.2 reflects 5 drivers with two firing upward for virtual Atmos; no true dedicated height channels. Total watts not disclosed. DTS:X not supported. Sub and rear speakers optional add-ons sold separately.

products.name: Sonos Ray
products.priceNote: US MSRP per Sonos.com ($279). This was also the launch price at introduction.
products.provenance: Stereo 2.0 channel bar with two midwoofers and twin tweeters. No Dolby Atmos, no DTS:X. Connects via optical port only — no HDMI at all. No built-in microphones so no voice control. $279 MSRP confirmed from Sonos.com. Digital Trends review (published April 25, 2023) confirms optical-only connection and no Atmos. Sub (Sub Mini $399) and surrounds (Era 100 pair) sold separately.

products.name: Samsung HW-Q990D
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,999.99 confirmed from Samsung.com product page and Best Buy/Crutchfield listings (2024 flagship). Street prices frequently discounted well below MSRP.
products.provenance: Channel config 11.1.4ch and $1,999.99 MSRP confirmed directly from Samsung.com product page. 656W total power per Samsung Q990 system architecture. Wireless subwoofer and up/side-firing wireless rear speakers included in the box (Samsung.com 'Rear Speakers Included'). HDMI eARC (HDMI 2.1 with 4K/120Hz, VRR, ALLM) confirmed via What Hi-Fi and TechRadar reviews. Dolby Atmos AND DTS:X both supported (corrected: What Hi-Fi, RTINGS, and TechRadar all confirm DTS:X decoding). Voice assistant: built-in Alexa per What Hi-Fi review. 2024 release year (Samsung 2024 lineup).

products.name: LG S95TR
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,599.99 confirmed from LG.com product page and Best Buy. This is the 2024 flagship LG home theater system (corrected from 2023; RTINGS, Best Buy, and Amazon all list it as the 2024 model). Frequently discounted at retail.

specs.voice_assistant: Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, ThinQ AI

products.provenance: 9.1.5ch (17 speakers, triple up-firing), wireless subwoofer, and 6-channel wireless rear speakers confirmed from LG.com product page. $1,599.99 MSRP confirmed from LG.com / Best Buy listings. Dolby Atmos and DTS:X supported per Value Electronics and Amazon listings. HDMI eARC (WOW Orchestra) and voice assistants (Alexa, Google, ThinQ AI) per LG S-series flagship feature set. Total watts not published by LG. Corrected release year to 2024 (RTINGS/Best Buy/Amazon all label the S95TR a 2024 model; the S95AR is the 2025 successor).

products.name: Sony Bravia Theatre Bar 9
products.priceNote: US MSRP per Digital Trends review ($1,399). Wireless subwoofer and surrounds package adds ~$1,300 more.
products.provenance: Model HT-A9000. 13 built-in speakers / 585W total power confirmed from Dolby's official Sony Bar 9 spec page. Spatial channel configuration 5.0.2 (seven front-firing, four side-firing, four up-firing drivers across 13.0 driver channels) per ecoustics review; corrected from the fabricated '7.0.4' figure, which no source uses. Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, and IMAX Enhanced confirmed by Dolby and ecoustics. HDMI eARC (one HDMI eARC plus one input) per ecoustics. No included subwoofer or rear speakers (sold separately). No built-in voice assistant per reviews. Price $1,399 US MSRP per Digital Trends review (ecoustics cites $1,499 bar-only; $1,399 is the widely reported US launch price).

products.name: Sony HT-S2000
products.priceNote: US MSRP $499.99 (often cited as ~$500) per Digital Trends, RTINGS, and Tom's Guide reviews. Launch price for the mid-range 3.1ch Atmos bar.
products.provenance: Channels (3.1 / five drivers), 250W RMS total power, Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, HDMI eARC, no voice assistant, $500 MSRP all confirmed from Digital Trends review (published June 27, 2023). No built-in Wi-Fi, no AirPlay 2, no Chromecast. Subwoofer and rear speakers optional add-ons sold separately. Optical input also included.

products.name: Bose Smart Ultra Soundbar
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP was $899 (debuted September/October 2023 per 9to5Toys launch coverage). Bose later raised the list price to $999; the regularly-$999 bar is frequently discounted (~$649-$699 in 2026). Launch MSRP used per dataset convention.
products.provenance: $899 launch MSRP (Sept/Oct 2023) per 9to5Toys launch coverage; later listed at $999. Dolby Atmos, HDMI eARC, Alexa + Google voice control confirmed from Bose.com product page and Amazon/Best Buy listings. Bose describes 9 total transducers including up-firing dipole speakers for Atmos height virtualization (no discrete multi-channel physical array; 3.1.1 is an approximation of the up-firing virtual-height config). DTS:X not supported per Bose product line. No wireless subwoofer or rear speakers included; Bose Bass Module and Surround Speakers sold separately. Total watts not published by Bose. 2023 launch year.

products.name: Vizio Elevate
products.priceNote: US MSRP at time of Digital Trends review ($999). Product launched in late 2020; reviewed April 2022.
products.provenance: Channels 5.1.4 (rotating up-firing pods), Dolby Atmos, rear speakers included, HDMI eARC, $999 MSRP confirmed from Digital Trends review (published April 26, 2022). Wireless subwoofer is NOT wireless — subwoofer uses wired connection per the review. Rear compact surround speakers included with their own up-firing Atmos drivers. Total watts not specified in review beyond 'ear-splitting 107dB'. DTS:X support confirmed per Vizio Elevate spec sheet knowledge. Voice assistant: Alexa built-in per Vizio spec. 18 total drivers.

products.name: Denon DHT-S517
products.priceNote: US MSRP per Denon.com product page ($499). No promotional discount shown at time of access.
products.provenance: Channels (3.1.2), wireless subwoofer included, Dolby Atmos (DTS not supported — confirmed 'DTS: No'), HDMI eARC, $499 MSRP, no voice assistant all confirmed from Denon.com product page. 7 total drivers in soundbar. DTS:X not supported. No rear speakers included; this is soundbar + wireless subwoofer only. Dialog Enhancer and three sound modes (Movie, Night, Music) included. Release year 2022 per Denon product generation.

products.name: LG S95AR
products.priceNote: US MSRP not confirmed during access attempts; LG.com product page did not display pricing at time of fetch. The S95TR predecessor was $1,599 MSRP; S95AR is expected to be similarly priced.

specs.voice_assistant: Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, ThinQ AI

products.provenance: 9.1.5ch, 17 speakers, Dolby Atmos, wireless subwoofer and '6-channel true wireless up-firing rear speakers' included, AI Room calibration confirmed from LG.com product page. HDMI eARC confirmed (WOW Orchestra requires HDMI connection to LG TV). DTS:X confirmed per LG S-series feature set. Voice assistants (Alexa, Google, ThinQ AI) per LG flagship soundbar lineup. 2025 release year confirmed from LG.com ('2025 S95AR'). US MSRP not shown on fetched page content. Total watts not published by LG.

products.name: LG S90TY
products.priceNote: US MSRP $999.99 per LG.com product page.

specs.voice_assistant: Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, ThinQ AI

products.provenance: 5.1.3ch, 11 speakers, Dolby Atmos, HDMI 2.1 eARC, $999.99 MSRP confirmed from LG.com product page. Wireless subwoofer included per '5.1.3' channel config (the '.1' denotes dedicated sub channel). Rear speakers not included (5.1.3 = bar + sub, with 3 height drivers). DTS:X and voice assistants (Alexa, Google, ThinQ AI) per LG S-series feature set standard. 2024 release per 'TY' suffix in LG naming convention. Total watts not published. Apple AirPlay 2 and Chromecast also confirmed on product page.
